# meraki_organization_sase_site_attachment (Resource)

This resource allows attaching a network to Cisco Secure Access as a SASE site. Attaching and detaching are asynchronous, so the site can take some time to appear after creation. The resource cannot be imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_organization_sase_site_attachment" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456"
  network_id      = "N_1234567890"
  region_slug     = "us-west-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) ID of the network to attach
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID
- `region_slug` (String) Slug of the Secure Access region to attach the site to

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `site_id` (String) ID of the SASE site, once the attachment has completed
